operational.TMPDIR: where a suite writes its scratch; the nightly's conditions set it
operational.RICHOS_UI_NAV_EVIDENCE_DIR: where a navigation failure writes its evidence
operational.RICHOS_TEST_RESULTS_ROOT: the runner's per-check results folder, where a differing or regenerated picture leaves its evidence

richos/app/ui/tests/lib/harness.js.require(c): loadPlaywright tries each Playwright candidate path in turn; whatever loads is bound as an install by content (portable_dependencies), in the same order

richos/app/ui/tests/lib/quiet-browser.js.spawn(executable: spawnQuietChrome starts the full Chrome binary its caller names, for the extension suites under richos/tools (native-transport-e2e.mjs, live-capture.mjs), which are not rows of this family; no ui-suite family suite calls it, and loadPlaywright installs only quiet-browser.js's option checks, which spawn nothing

richos/app/ui/tests/lib/navigation-evide.spawnSync(file: helper() is called only with /usr/sbin/sysctl and /bin/ps, to record host pressure in a navigation-failure bundle; system programs, no repository code, never a verdict input

splash.js.why: check 18 opens, beside each splash-library.js entry, the round study its source names in the private richos-hq repository, when that repository exists

unqualified.vouch-template.js: downloads the vouch release with curl from the network; its digest-verified cache is test output, not a bound input
